summary: Slime and magma cube spawners crash the game
description: The bug When you put a slime egg into a spanner, it crashes your game, and when you try to get on the same world, it crashes the game until you break it. How to reproduce - /give @s minecraft:spawner - /give @s minecraft:slime_spawn_egg - Place down the spawner - Right click it with the spawn egg Game crashes Crash report 19w35a : [^crash-2019-09-02_03.56.07-client.txt] Description: Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Attribute is already registered! at akr.b(SourceFile:29) at akt.b(SourceFile:30) at awf.a(SourceFile:89) at awf.a(SourceFile:341) at bib.d(SourceFile:256) at drb.a(SourceFile:20) at drb.a(SourceFile:15) at drb.a(SourceFile:10) at dqq.a(SourceFile:139) at dqq.a(SourceFile:121) at dow.a(SourceFile:606) at dos.b(SourceFile:840) at dos.a(SourceFile:747) at dos.a(SourceFile:613) at czq.e(SourceFile:941) at czq.b(SourceFile:402) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:194) A detailed walkthrough of the error, its code path and all known details is as follows: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Head -- Thread: Render thread Stacktrace: at akr.b(SourceFile:29) at akt.b(SourceFile:30) at awf.a(SourceFile:89) at awf.a(SourceFile:341) at bib.d(SourceFile:256) at drb.a(SourceFile:20) at drb.a(SourceFile:15) at drb.a(SourceFile:10) -- Block Entity Details -- Details: Name: minecraft:mob_spawner // bwb Block: Block{minecraft:spawner} Block location: World: (-53,63,0), Chunk: (at 11,3,0 in -4,0; contains blocks -64,0,0 to -49,255,15), Region: (-1,0; contains chunks -32,0 to -1,31, blocks -512,0,0 to -1,255,511) Block: Block{minecraft:spawner} Block location: World: (-53,63,0), Chunk: (at 11,3,0 in -4,0; contains blocks -64,0,0 to -49,255,15), Region: (-1,0; contains chunks -32,0 to -1,31, blocks -512,0,0 to -1,255,511) Stacktrace: at dqq.a(SourceFile:139) at dqq.a(SourceFile:121) at dow.a(SourceFile:606) at dos.b(SourceFile:840) at dos.a(SourceFile:747)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft in Creative mode with default settings.
2. Execute the command: `/give @s minecraft:spawner`.
3. Execute the command: `/give @s minecraft:slime_spawn_egg`.
4. Place a mob spawner on the ground.
5. Right-click the placed mob spawner using the slime spawn egg.
6. Observe that the game crashes immediately upon right-clicking the spawner with the slime spawn egg.
7. Attempt to load the same world again and observe that the game continues to crash until the spawner is broken or removed.
8. Take a screenshot of the crash message if possible, and gather any relevant `debug` folder contents for further analysis.
Observed Behavior:
When a slime egg is placed into a mob spawner, it causes the game to crash immediately. Subsequently, attempting to load the world in which this occurred results in repeated crashes until the problematic spawner is removed. To reproduce the issue, first use `/give @s minecraft:spawner` and `/give @s minecraft:slime_spawn_egg` commands to obtain a mob spawner and a slime spawn egg. Place down the spawner, then right-click it with the slime spawn egg. This action will trigger a crash. The game's crash report from version 19w35a indicates an error related to rendering the block entity, specifically a java.lang.IllegalArgumentException stating that an attribute is already registered. The stack trace points to issues within the game’s code when attempting to process the spawner with a slime egg.

The detailed walkthrough of the error shows that the issue occurs on the Render thread and involves specific classes such as `akr`, `akt`, and `awf`. The crash report also provides block entity details, including the location at World: (-53,63,0), which is within Chunk: -4,0. This detailed information helps pinpoint where in the world the problematic spawner was placed.

The critical part of this bug report highlights that the game crashes due to an attribute registration issue when a slime spawn egg is used with a mob spawner. This crash persists until the offending spawner is removed from the world.
Expected Behavior: When a slime egg is placed in a mob spawner, the game should not crash. Instead, the spawner should successfully be set to spawn slimes or magma cubes as intended. The world should remain stable and load without issues, allowing players to interact with the spawner normally.
